# Runnable implementation

Place the runnable implementation for this voice agent in this directory. This package intentionally contains no executable application code, provider credentials, or simulated integration.

Use [`../SPEC.md`](../SPEC.md) as the implementation contract before adding application code.

## Expected setup and testing conventions

Use the repository-established runtime, package manager, formatter, lint command, test runner, and CI conventions. Document setup, required environment variables, local development, call fixtures, and targeted unit, integration, and end-to-end checks when implementation is added. Validate escalation, transfer, identity or consent gates, integration failures, and success metrics before release.
